name: Ookami-kun to Akazukin-chan
original_name: 狼くんと赤頭巾ちゃん
source:
Once there lived a wolfboy and a girl in a red hood in the forest together.
The girl in the red hood wanted to have a baby,
and so for her sake the wolfboy gave it his best!
A heartwarming babymaking story.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE162062.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
从前，森林里住着一个小狼和一个戴着红头巾的女孩。
红头巾的女孩想要一个孩子，
所以为了她，狼童竭尽全力！
一个温馨的育儿故事。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE162062.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
